nodes.label: bootstrapUser with pg_advisory_xact_lock
nodes.rationale: Advisory lock taken only when user looks new, so parallel requests of existing users never queue; double-checked to survive the race.

nodes.label: createVerifier (jose, ES256/RS256 only)
nodes.rationale: Restricting algorithms prevents HS256 algorithm confusion; legacy shared-secret projects fail closed.

nodes.label: Data routers (categories, goals, subgoals, tasks, streaks, ideas, vision items, settings)
nodes.norm_label: data routers (categories, goals, subgoals, tasks, streaks, ideas, vision items, settings)

nodes.label: errorHandler status mapping
nodes.rationale: 500s never leak raw database or stack messages; Postgres class 22/23 errors map to 400.

nodes.label: makeHandle / Handle / Ctx request wrapper
nodes.rationale: tz parsed lazily so only routes that need it require X-Timezone; afterCommit runs post-COMMIT so objects are removed only once row change is durable.

nodes.label: migrate() migration runner with advisory lock
nodes.norm_label: migrate() migration runner with advisory lock

nodes.label: today(tz) / localDateOf / parseTimezone helpers
nodes.rationale: Uses Intl formatToParts with en-US instead of relying on en-CA output; rejects offsets like UTC+3.

nodes.label: Hostile request bodies return 400 without SQL text
nodes.norm_label: hostile request bodies return 400 without sql text

nodes.label: esbuild bundle with extensionless imports
nodes.rationale: Copied code uses extensionless imports; tsx, Vitest and esbuild resolve them; tsc only --noEmit.

nodes.label: DELETE /api/account route
nodes.rationale: Order: remove images, delete rows, delete auth user; mounted before tombstone check so a half-failed delete is retryable.

nodes.label: safeNext / isPublicRoute route guard helpers
nodes.rationale: Prevents open redirects via next parameter (//evil, /\evil, absolute URLs).

nodes.label: SvelteKit App HTML Shell (app.html)
nodes.rationale: Uses data-sveltekit-preload-data="hover" and viewport-fit=cover for mobile safe areas.

nodes.label: Four Delivery Phases (API, web, k8s local, cloud)

nodes.label: Kubernetes Deployment (local cluster first)
nodes.rationale: Owner wants to learn Kubernetes; local kind/minikube first, cloud cluster in phase 4.

nodes.label: Server/Web types.ts Byte-Identity Rule
nodes.rationale: Prevents API type drift between server and web client; API extras like imageUrl live in a separate view type.

nodes.label: How Sign-In and Data Access Work (auth.md)
nodes.norm_label: how sign-in and data access work (auth.md)

nodes.label: Account Deletion with deleted_users Tombstone
nodes.rationale: Tombstone first because access tokens stay valid until expiry; idempotent steps allow retry; DELETE /account skips the check so retry works.

nodes.label: Guard loading/redirecting Flags
nodes.rationale: Prevents guard and 401 callback both signing out; invalidateAll() rerun design loops and was rejected.

nodes.label: PKCE Flow (verifier in localStorage, detectSessionInUrl false)
nodes.norm_label: pkce flow (verifier in localstorage, detectsessioninurl false)
nodes.rationale: Someone who intercepts the email alone cannot use the link; only the callback page reads codes, keeping exchanges in one place.

nodes.label: Express 5 API Server on Node
nodes.rationale: Owner knows Express; Hono and FastAPI dropped. API runs as its own server so the owner can learn Kubernetes; Edge Functions or direct Supabase RLS were simpler but rejected for that reason.

nodes.label: Supabase JWKS Token Verification
nodes.rationale: Uses published signing keys so the cluster needs only the project URL, not a shared secret; tests use a local key pair.

nodes.label: Private Bucket Images via Signed URLs
nodes.norm_label: private bucket images via signed urls

nodes.label: Supabase (Postgres, auth, storage)
nodes.rationale: One free service covers database, auth and file storage; cost: free projects pause when idle, auth accounts hardest to migrate away.

nodes.label: Bearer-Token API Usable by Non-Browser Clients
nodes.norm_label: bearer-token api usable by non-browser clients
nodes.rationale: Desktop and mobile clients must call the same API, so no cookie-only auth or CORS-only protections.

nodes.label: Email Verification and Ingress Rate Limiting
nodes.norm_label: email verification and ingress rate limiting
nodes.rationale: Unverified users never get a session, so API needs no check; abuse protection via Supabase auth limits plus ingress rate limits, no limiter in API.

nodes.label: Owner Key: Supabase user_id uuid (no users table)
nodes.norm_label: owner key: supabase user_id uuid (no users table)
nodes.rationale: No FK to auth.users so local dev and tests run on plain Postgres.

nodes.label: Postgres Row-Level Security Isolation
nodes.rationale: Each request sets app.user_id in one transaction; policies restrict rows so a forgotten WHERE user_id filter cannot leak data. Revised after review from per-query filtering.

nodes.label: X-Timezone Header for Local Dates
nodes.rationale: Streaks depend on local calendar dates; the server must not use its own clock. Header is trusted: a user falsifying it only harms their own streaks.

nodes.label: Login by Email Only (username login deferred)
nodes.norm_label: login by email only (username login deferred)
nodes.rationale: Username login needs a server login proxy, reversing "API has no auth endpoints", puts password guessing on our API, and shares Supabase per-IP rate limits.

nodes.label: optimistic() helper with per-key sequencing
nodes.rationale: Latest intent wins per key; stale responses ignored to avoid revert flicker on rapid clicks.

nodes.label: Two-user Playwright E2E with admin-created users
nodes.norm_label: two-user playwright e2e with admin-created users

nodes.label: Delete Account Flow (storage, rows, auth user)
nodes.norm_label: delete account flow (storage, rows, auth user)

nodes.label: Phase 2 Risks (Supabase pause, signed URL expiry)
nodes.norm_label: phase 2 risks (supabase pause, signed url expiry)

nodes.label: Unique Usernames via profiles table
nodes.rationale: Unique index enforced across all rows regardless of RLS, so usernames are globally unique while profiles stay private.

nodes.label: Deleted-User Tombstone
nodes.rationale: Tokens verified offline stay valid up to an hour after deletion; tombstone rejects them so other tabs cannot recreate orphan rows/images.

nodes.label: E2E against real Supabase test project
nodes.norm_label: e2e against real supabase test project
nodes.rationale: Chosen over a stub JWKS server; admin-created pre-confirmed users.

nodes.label: Runtime /config.json
nodes.rationale: One build runs in any environment; phase 3 mounts config from a ConfigMap.

nodes.label: Targeted Optimistic Updates
nodes.rationale: Network adds two serial round trips; direct-manipulation updates instantly while server-computed numbers catch up. Anti-goal: duplicating server business rules in the browser.

nodes.label: createVerifier() JWT Verifier (jose, ES256/RS256)
nodes.rationale: Only public keys are needed, so the API never holds a secret that could mint tokens; HS256 fails closed.

nodes.label: Additive Migrations 0001-0005
nodes.rationale: Migrations only add, so the previous server version keeps working on the migrated database.

nodes.label: Live Smoke Test Results 2026-11-08
nodes.rationale: CDN may keep serving deleted objects via earlier signed URLs for up to 1 hour.

nodes.label: Supabase Setup (asymmetric JWT keys, private vision bucket 5 MB)
nodes.norm_label: supabase setup (asymmetric jwt keys, private vision bucket 5 mb)

nodes.label: Migrate Before Deploy
nodes.rationale: New version needs 0003-0005; additive migrations keep the previous version working.

nodes.label: withUser() Transaction Scope
nodes.rationale: set_config(..., true) is transaction-local so pooled connections never carry one user id into the next request.

nodes.label: own_rows RLS Policy (FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY)
nodes.norm_label: own_rows rls policy (force row level security)

nodes.label: First-Request Bootstrap (settings + 5 default categories, advisory lock)
nodes.norm_label: first-request bootstrap (settings + 5 default categories, advisory lock)

nodes.label: API Request Lifecycle (authenticate, withUser tx, afterCommit, errorHandler)
nodes.norm_label: api request lifecycle (authenticate, withuser tx, aftercommit, errorhandler)

nodes.label: API Conventions (/api base, bearer auth, X-Timezone, error shape)
nodes.norm_label: api conventions (/api base, bearer auth, x-timezone, error shape)

nodes.label: Slow Work After Commit (sign URLs, remove replaced images)
nodes.norm_label: slow work after commit (sign urls, remove replaced images)
nodes.rationale: Signing URLs and removing images after COMMIT never holds a transaction open.

nodes.label: Client-Supplied Time Zone (X-Timezone header)
nodes.rationale: Server uses its own clock converted to the user's IANA zone; client sends only the zone name, never its date/time.

nodes.label: RLS as Isolation Boundary
nodes.rationale: Every table has user_id defaulting to current_setting(app.user_id); repository SQL has no per-query filter, so another user's id answers 404, never data.
